title: metadata: an object bound to a datasource that does not exist publishes successfully, and is then silently unregistered (data calls 404 "not registered"); Studio still lists it
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

A typo in `datasource` is accepted at save and publish ("published"), but the object never registers, so every data call answers 404 and nothing tells the author why.

## Reproduction

1. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/gapdata_badds?mode=draft&package=com.example.gapdata` with `"datasource": "gapdata_nosuch"` (and again with `"nope_ds_2"`) → 200; publish-drafts → "published".
2. `POST /api/v1/data/gapdata_badds` → 404 "Object 'gapdata_badds' is not registered".
3. Studio Data rail still lists "Bad DS".

## Expected

Refused at save or publish with a located error naming the unknown datasource.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

Object save/publish validation of `datasource` against the registered datasources (metadata publish pipeline / object registration).

## Filing facts

- reach: `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/…` + publish + `/api/v1/data`, measured twice by the data gap-fill card.
- Business reason: Authors and AI agents get "published" for an object that cannot be used, with no pointer to the cause.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:server`, `area:data`, p2.
- Dedupe: semantic search `object with unknown datasource publishes then data calls 404 not registered` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 7 hits, none about publish accepting an unknown datasource (nearest closed #25486, #21923).
- QA id: G9
